blocks.translation:
• Caution — To customers who purchased this product: Read this information before use.
• The target age for this product is 15 years and older. Do not give it to children younger than the target age under any circumstances.
• This product contains small parts and batteries; keep them away from small children so they do not swallow them by mistake. There is a risk of choking.
• There are sharp and pointed parts; take care when handling and storing the product. Unexpected injuries may occur.
• Do not use the product close to the ear. Incorrect use may damage hearing.
• This product contains electronic components. If you use a pacemaker, do not bring this product close to your body.
• Do not stare at the blinking LED light. It may cause nausea or other discomfort.
• Incorrect battery use can cause heating, rupture or leakage. Observe the following precautions.
• Do not use secondary (rechargeable) batteries under any circumstances.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries together.
• Insert the batteries with the correct +/− polarity.
• After playing, always turn the switch off and remove the batteries. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage and is dangerous.
• Do not short-circuit, recharge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into fire.
• If battery fluid gets into the eyes, rinse immediately with plenty of water and consult a doctor. If it contacts skin or clothing, wash with water.
• When disposing of batteries, follow your local government’s waste-disposal instructions.

blocks.text: 《使用上の注意》

●本商品は精密に作られています。無理な力を加えたり、落としたりすると破損する恐れがあります。 本商品は精密な電子部品で
構成されています。 落としたり、水に濡らしたり、汚したり、分解したりしないでください。 また、高温・低温になるところでの使用、
保管はさけてください。 プラスチック梱包材は、開封後はすぐに捨ててください。●本商品には塗装部分がありますので、保管の
際には他のもの (樹脂製品や家具、ソファー)と接触しないようにしてください。 色が移る場合があります。 ●可動部分・取付部分を
無理な方向に強く引っ張ったり、曲げたりしないでください。 発音の一部にイントネーションが違っていたり、 商品の特性上聞き
取りにくいものがありますが、ご了承ください。 ●本商品にはセンタイギア以外はセットしないでください。故障や破損の原因と
なります。 ●本体にトジルギアをセットしないでください。故障や破損の原因となります。
blocks.translation:
• This product is precision-made. Applying excessive force or dropping it may cause damage.
• This product contains precision electronic components. Do not drop it, get it wet, dirty it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it where it will become very hot or very cold. Discard plastic packing material immediately after opening.
• This product has painted parts. When storing, keep it from contacting other items (plastic products, furniture, sofas), as color may transfer.
• Do not strongly pull or bend movable or attached parts in directions they are not meant to move.
• Some voice lines have different intonation or may be hard to hear due to the product's characteristics.
• Do not set anything other than Sentai Gear in this product. Doing so may cause malfunction or damage.
• Do not set Tojiru Gear on the main unit. Doing so may cause malfunction or damage.

blocks.text: いいよ。協力してくれたら、

blocks.translation: I'll take you to Tojitendo Palace.
